title: sanguisorba sanguisorba var. delortii
intro: Sanguisorba sanguisorba var. delortii, commonly known as Burnet, is a perennial herb belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Burnet include soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Burnet include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
